properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 9:13AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 39.5 feet
early tomorrow afternoon.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 10:56AM EDT until July 30 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
At 1056 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the warned
area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. The expected
rainfall rate may reach 1 inch in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
South Kingstown, Westerly, Narragansett, Hopkinton, Charlestown,
Richmond and Exeter.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 30 at 11:02AM EDT until July 30 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm...

* Until noon EDT.

* At 1102 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Port Orange,
moving southeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
New Smyrna Beach, New Smyrna Beach Airport, Bethune Beach, Turtle
Mound, and Port Orange.

properties.areaDesc: Albany, NY; Columbia, NY; Greene, NY; Rensselaer, NY
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 9:42AM EDT until July 30 at 6:30PM EDT by NWS Albany NY
properties.description:
* WHAT...Residual flooding caused by leftover runoff from excessive
rainfall.

* WHERE...A portion of east central New York, including the
following counties, Albany, Columbia, Greene and Rensselaer.

* WHEN...Until 630 PM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is still occurring in some areas. A few
roads remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings may be
inundated with water and may not be passable. Expect areas of slow
moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 934 AM EDT, Residual flooding is still occurring across
parts of the area with a few roads remaining closed.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hudson, Chatham, Nassau, New Baltimore, Ravena, Coxsackie,
Valatie, Athens, Castleton-On-Hudson, Philmont, Kinderhook,
Lorenz Park, Selkirk, Claverack-Red Mills, Coeymans, Ghent,
Stockport, Stuyvesant, Sunnyside and Stuyvesant Falls.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 30 at 11:00AM EDT until July 30 at 11:15AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
At 1100 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Flagler Beach,
moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Flagler Beach.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 7:39AM MST until July 30 at 9:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST /1045 AM MDT/.

* At 739 AM MST /839 AM MDT/, automated river gauges on the Paria
River near Lees Ferry indicated that the flood wave has arrived.
More than a 4 foot rise was detected around 530 AM MST. Levels are
slowly falling. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding in and around the Paria
River.

SOURCE...Gauge indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Paria River and Colorado River.
properties.instruction:
Get away from the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters are flowing
down the Paria River.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:45 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:45 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
